title: Embedding fidelity probe and drift orchestrator
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a reusable evaluation orchestrator for embedding accuracy and distributional drift that runs nightly offline checks, computes a standardized set of metrics (MRR@k, Recall@k, mean cosine shift, PSI), and surfaces alerts to Console and PagerDuty. The orchestrator should support: (1) multiple golden/reference sets per customer/workload, (2) pluggable metric modules, (3) a compact report for quick triage, and (4) automated baseline recalibration workflows when a deliberate model change is rolled out.
background: We currently have ad-hoc embedding evaluation scripts in multiple repos that produce inconsistent metrics and no reliable drift alerts. This causes late detection of quality regressions after model swaps and increases incident toil on reliability and customer success teams.
scope: Nightly offline evaluator service + alerting integration + one example golden set onboarding flow. Provide extensible adapters for new metrics and for reranking evaluation. Integrator will emit standardized telemetry to Console (embedding_quality.*) and write canonical CSV/Parquet artifacts to s3://redwood-embed-evals/.
non_goals: Real-time online drift blocking, model rollback automation, or end-to-end integration with Dedicated autoscaling in this ticket. Those are follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job is scheduled and runs with no more than 30m variance in start time
Report includes MRR@1/5/10, Recall@1/5, NDCG@10, mean cosine shift, pairwise variance, and PSI per golden set
Console dashboard shows tokenized telemetry and a link to the Artifacts page for the generated golden reports
Alerts fire to the embeddings channel and PagerDuty when preset thresholds for drift or MRR drop are exceeded
Onboarding doc demonstrates adding a new golden set and configuring thresholds within 15 minutes
tasks: Design schema for golden set metadata (id, owner, canonical queries, expected top-k labels, retention policy)
Implement metric modules: mrr, recall, ndcg, cosine-distribution-shift, psi
Create orchestrator runner (k8s CronJob + local dev runner) that enumerates golden sets and executes evaluation
Emit standardized telemetry to Console: embedding_quality.mrr, embedding_quality.psi, embedding_quality.mean_cosine_shift
Wire alerting: create PagerDuty escalation policy + Slack channel integration
Write onboarding doc and a sample golden set for the reranker internal test workload
End-to-end QA with synthetic drift injections and a targeted canary dataset
decisions: Store binary embedding artifacts as float16 Parquet in s3 to balance storage and compatibility
Use cosine similarity as default distance metric with option to plug in dot-product for specific models
Initial drift detector will compute PSI + a sliding-window cosine centroid shift and use conservative thresholds; later iterate with ML-based detectors if false positives rate is high
Run evaluations in a separate infra namespace to isolate quota and GPU/CPU burst from serving clusters
